column1: # Target: IconToBitmapColorTable, RVA 0xd32a0, retail size 0x5af, target relocations 91.

# Scope: new whole-function command-loop ownership and branch-body order derived from retail before consulting the canonical body. No recorded setup/include/predicate/count/byte-offset/SSA/pointer-view family was replayed.

# Retail lifetime proof: gCTDst is loaded into EBX at +0xe5 before loop header +0xeb and is never reloaded on a backedge; EBX is published on skip, then becomes the dim/literal destination cursor. Newline publishes X0, increments Y, loads pitch, advances row, then stores Y at +0x587..+0x5a0.
# No regex/AST permutation tool was used. The retained threshold is the campaign maximum 72.479%, not the lower live canonical score.
# Restored canonical verification: normalized source hash d70464fd672d, .text SHA-256 54b5211334240ba1749c8c53f253abd40b8fd28039b7b55fb15985bf99ffb157, size 0x57e, 91/91 relocations.

column5: Checkpoint canonical: reloads gCTDst at the command-loop header; retained campaign maximum remains 72.479%.

Moved the gCTDst load before the loop so one cursor survives every backedge. This newly recovers the retail publication lifetime and self-store on the skip edge, but colors cursor=EDX and count=EBX instead of retail cursor=EBX/count=EDX.
Used cmd=*gCTSrc++ for the main command fetch. It did not recover retail's source=ECX/cmd=EAX allocation and reduced the score.
Initialized the loop-carried cursor while dest was still live, before row formation. This blocked EDX but made cursor=ESI and X=EBX, the reverse of retail's X=ESI/cursor=EBX.
Extended cmd/count/flags declaration scopes across the loop. MSVC retained cursor=EDX and count=EBX; the wider state did not recover the retail coloring.
Declared the cursor at its initialization immediately before the loop. The narrower source scope improved the whole decoder, but lost one ClipR, one Cnt, and one X0 relocation versus retail.

Combined the loop-carried cursor with retail's X/Y/row newline order; object SHA-256 3292148079c0ae9040468e5ee673eb40193712ecaa2bc58b7737275c18676262, .text size 0x58b. Literal publication order and cmd unsignedness/name changes were byte-neutral. Still 0.599 points below the retained threshold.
Used paired source/destination post-increments for the mapped literal loop. It moved side effects toward retail and lengthened the function, but globally worsened allocation and score.
Materialized a per-command source cursor before publishing gCTSrc. MSVC emitted LEA old+1 and kept pointer=EAX/cmd=ECX rather than retail pointer=ECX/cmd=EAX.
Decoded count once for both skip and shadow command classes. Retail computes it only after the bit-0x40 split; the unified lifetime introduced an early AND and regressed.
Made count signed to reflect the later >0 tests. It recovered count=EDX but swapped X=EBX/cursor=ESI and broadly changed shadow/fill lowering.
Removed the redundant owner-header parse as a new TU-state probe. Private suffixes moved only S1669..S1685 to S1654..S1670 (15, not the required state), changed compare polarity, and regressed.

Canonical body restored because no genuinely new whole-function state exceeded 72.479%. The durable source note now records the proven pre-loop cursor/newline evidence for a future combined setup+decoder model.
